## Change and scope

Describe the behavior changed and link the spec/task IDs. Do not remove approved tools to make a dependency fit.

## Verification

- [ ] Record commands, dependency/runtime versions, OS, and actual results.
- [ ] Run Biome, TypeScript, relevant Python checks, and regression tests.
- [ ] Preserve EN/VI input, editing state, and source media.
- [ ] For dependency changes, commit the genuine lockfile and review release notes, engines, peer dependencies, licenses, and native assets.
- [ ] Separate UI/installer/model results from mocked or pure unit tests.

## Remaining limits

State skipped/blocked checks and rollback considerations. No automatic approval of paid/public actions or unresolved product policies.
